subject: POC: retention carveout + BYOK/KMS options / SSO evidence — triage
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@clearcloud.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Anika Patel <anika@clearcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: POC - short retention carveout & BYOK question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We want to move forward with a two-week POC that ingests a small set of customer queries. Two compliance items before we kick off: (1) Can audit logs for the POC be retained only for 7 days and then auto-deleted (ClearCloud legal needs a short retention window for PII in pilot data)? (2) For the POC can you support a temporary BYOK arrangement where ClearCloud holds the KMS key or we use a customer-managed key in a restricted escrow?

Also we need SSO evidence (SAML metadata, IdP config screenshots) and a minimal evidence packet for our security review by next Friday. We know production is different — this is strictly for the pilot.

What information do you need from us to scope this? We can be flexible on logs format if that helps.

Jordan
Senior Cloud Engineer, ClearCloud
From: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@clearcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC - short retention carveout & BYOK question

Jordan — thanks, this is clear and reasonable for a scoped pilot. Quick plan to triage internally and come back with a mutual action plan:

- Short-term retention: evaluate feasibility of a 7-day TTL for audit logs specifically for POC tenants (impact on index / storage layer).
- BYOK: confirm options — (A) customer-provided key in our KMS integration (supported but requires policy carveouts), (B) temporary key escrow workflow (manual exchange) as an interim.
- SSO evidence: we can provide SAML config screenshots + test assertion logs + summary of SSO controls.

I’m looping product, infra, and compliance on what we need to commit to in this sprint. Can you share (a) an example small log file (anonymized) and (b) the exact legal language about the 7-day retention requirement?

I’ll schedule a 30-min triage for tomorrow 11am PT and attach an initial action tracker.

—Tessa
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan@clearcloud.com>, Anika Patel <anika@clearcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 13:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC - short retention carveout & BYOK question

Adding product context / ask:

We can support a pilot-scoped retention TTL on the audit-log index if we implement a tenant-level retention flag + background compaction job. For POC we should avoid adding a permanent flag to the main product surface — propose an SDK/flag we flip for the ClearCloud tenant only, then roll back after the pilot. Impact notes: (a) SST metrics will be slightly noisier for two weeks, (b) we need a one-line sentinel in the logs that identifies pilot entries (to avoid accidental long-term archive).

BYOK: Product prefers option A (customer-managed key via existing KMS integration) but that requires infra to validate key policies + timeline to enable. Option B (manual escrow) is acceptable short-term but requires legal sign-off and a documented handoff procedure.

Action items I propose for triage call:
- Karthik to confirm KMS policy gating and estimate hours (infra).
- Evelyn to list compliance evidence we must provide for POC.
- Jordan to upload an anonymized sample log.
- Tessa to own the mutual action plan and sprint tickets.

Marissa
Director, Product Management, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan@clearcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC - short retention carveout & BYOK question

On Tue, Dec 7, 2026 at 1:08 PM Marissa Cole wrote:
> Adding product context / ask:

Quick infra assessment:

- 7-day TTL: technically straightforward if we treat POC logs as ephemeral objects routed to a separate S3 prefix + lifecycle rule. Work: ~1-2 engineer-days to wire tenant routing + lifecycle policy and tests. We can avoid changing the main index by standing up a small ephemeral log sink.
- KMS/BYOK: We currently support customer-managed keys for persistent customer data, but onboarding a key requires: key policy validation, metadata mapping, and KMS access-scoped roles. That onboarding path takes ~2-3 sprint days if we do it properly. For a fast pilot I recommend temporary escrow: we do an encrypted export each night to a customer-provided bucket using a short-lived wrapping key — documented handoff, no long-term key import.
- SSO evidence: we can provide SAML metadata + test assertion logs; I can produce a redacted assertion sample.

I’ll put a small spike ticket and estimate tomorrow. If product wants the full KMS onboarding in this sprint, we need to deprioritize a separate infra task.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan@clearcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 11:46:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC - short retention carveout & BYOK question

Thanks — a few compliance constraints for clarity:

- The POC-level 7-day retention is acceptable for evidence as long as ClearCloud signs a POC addendum acknowledging the limited scope and that production will follow standard retention. We need that doc before we apply the TTL.
- Evidence packet required for ClearCloud security review: SAML metadata + test assertion (redacted), brief SSO config summary, confirmation of nightly export procedure, and a short list of what we purge at day 7.
- Audit trail: include a change log entry describing the tenant flag + who toggled it (auditability cannot be removed).

I can draft the POC addendum and a one-page evidence checklist. Target: deliver drafts by end of day Thursday so Jordan can forward to legal.

Evelyn
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: POC - short retention carveout & BYOK question

- Karthik: spike and PR for ephemeral sink + nightly encrypted export (temporary escrow flow). ETA: 5 business days.
- Marissa: create tenant sentinel log field and add a short UX note for ops. ETA: 3 business days.
- Evelyn: draft POC addendum + evidence checklist and confirm wording with Jordan. ETA: EOD Thu (draft attached).
- Jordan / ClearCloud: provide anonymized sample logs + legal POC wording by EOD Fri.

Attachments: redwood_poc_action_items.xlsx (action tracker), audit-log-sample-20261206.csv (anonymized sample).

Next steps: I’ll open sprint tickets and add the infra spike to the upcoming mini-sprint. If ClearCloud signs the addendum we enable the TTL and nightly export.

Jordan / Anika — please confirm receipt and if the Friday timeline works for legal.

—Tessa
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
